messages:
Alex (Finance): Heads up — invoice INV-2026-078 shows a ~120% overage on Dedicated commit for AcmeCorp in eu-west. Can someone confirm if cross-region failover consumed NY reserved pool?
Sara (Accounting): I saw that line. It looks like the reserved allocation id got re-attached to eu-west during the incident on 03/09. Pulling logs.
Jordan (Customer Success): Customer reporting surprise charge. They're asking for either credit or re-bill to the eu pool. They had a single reserved commit across us-east primarily.
Alex (Finance): What we need: (1) root cause, (2) whether overage is billable per contract, (3) recommended credit amount if internal. Priya — can RevOps sign off on pass-through to partner vendor?
Priya (Revenue Ops): If the failover routed to a non-reserved region, contract says we should credit for the burst if routing decision was ours. Send me the allocation IDs and timestamps.
Sara (Accounting): Here are the invoice lines:
```
INV-2026-078
line 3: reserved-commit us-east (commit id RC-2026-ACME-01) qty 720h price $10,000
line 4: burst eu-west 2026-03-09 18:02-18:47 1,200 units $3,600
```
And the routing log snippet:
```
2026-03-09T18:02:11Z route_decision: failover -> eu-west
alloc_map: RC-2026-ACME-01 -> eu-west (temp)
```
Alex (Finance): So it looks like the reserved pool was temporarily applied to eu-west — does that imply double-billing (reserved + burst)?
Jordan (Customer Success): From customer perspective they only expected reserved capacity to cover these requests. They want a good faith credit.
Priya (Revenue Ops): Based on contract clause 4.2, if we routed requests to a non-reserved region due to our control plane failover, we absorb the burst charges. I'll draft a credit memo for 100% of the burst line unless legal objects.
FinanceBot: Billing alert: Potential credit candidate flagged INV-2026-078. Tagging #finance for approval.
Alex (Finance): OK. Sara — can you create the credit memo draft and include the allocation logs? Jordan — please prep a short customer note. Priya — once you sign I'll route to Legal.
Sara (Accounting): Will do. Drafting now, will attach the logs and reference SLA credit playbook.
Jordan (Customer Success): I'll notify AcmeCorp that we're investigating and planning a credit. ETA 2 hours.
Priya (Revenue Ops): I'll approve the draft and ping Legal if needed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
